source_suites.name: SimpleTES
source_suites.task_contract: Each task supplies an instruction, an editable seed program, and an executable evaluator that validates constraints and recomputes the score in an isolated subprocess.

tasks.name: Asymmetric matrix multiplication
tasks.question: Implement a faster asymmetric matrix-multiplication GPU kernel without changing numerical semantics.
tasks.input: A seed Triton/CUDA kernel, fixed tensor shapes and dtypes, correctness tests, and a profiling harness.
tasks.evaluation: Correctness-gated execution followed by runtime profiling on the fixed benchmark workload.
tasks.environment: Triton/CUDA with a GPU profiling server; headline result uses H200.
tasks.integrity_notes: Runtime depends on hardware and profiler configuration; scores are source-reported and require matched-device replay.

tasks.name: Cassini gravity-assist trajectory
tasks.question: Find a feasible Cassini gravity-assist trajectory with lower total propulsive cost.
tasks.input: Mission window, body sequence/search variables, orbital constraints, a seed optimizer, and NAIF ephemeris kernels.
tasks.output: Trajectory-design program and feasible mission parameters
tasks.evaluation: The mission simulator validates feasibility and computes the fixed propulsive-cost objective.
tasks.environment: Python task environment with astrodynamics dependencies and NAIF kernels.
tasks.integrity_notes: Comparison is meaningful only under the same mission windows, simulator, constraints, and cost normalization.

tasks.name: Circle packing in a unit square (n=26)
tasks.question: Place 26 non-overlapping circles inside a unit square to maximize the sum of their radii.
tasks.input: A Python seed construction, geometric constraints, and an executable feasibility checker.
tasks.evaluation: Recompute boundary and non-overlap constraints, then sum all feasible radii.
tasks.environment: Python; no external task setup listed.
tasks.integrity_notes: Rounded values match; full-precision artifacts are required to establish equality or a strict improvement.

tasks.name: Erdős minimum overlap
tasks.question: Construct a feasible step function with unit mass that minimizes its worst translated one-sided overlap.
tasks.input: A discretized Python construction, integral and range constraints, and a fixed overlap evaluator.
tasks.evaluation: Validate range and mass constraints and recompute the supremum of the translated overlap objective.
tasks.environment: Python; no external task setup listed.
tasks.integrity_notes: This row preserves the rounded comparison table supplied for the task. Other SimpleTES versions report 0.380856, and later independent analysis raised normalization/certification issues; cite the exact artifact and recompute at full precision before claiming a record.
